item.title: The Spire - needs greenlights
item.content:encoded:
It's a chemically changing rock. Name is work in progress, and I'm not too happy with the discovery, so any help/suggestions would be nice

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) and titles short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Horror/intriguing?

Page Layout (Optional): Standard article. After description, will go over discovery, and after discovery will then go over test logs.

Elevator Pitch: It's a tall rock that slightly twists. The tip of it will be called element A, and the base of it will be called element B. If an object touches the tip, element A changes into the majority of the atoms in that object. There are various things that cause a teleport event, but when that happens, the spire disappears and reappears at a random spot on the earth. element B then becomes the old element A, element A becomes the closest solid element near the tip, and the spire absorbs every current element B atom in a 1km radius.

+ show block
– hide block

Central Narrative: It was discovered when a redacted reality bender started rampaging, and along with various other items it created the spire. Some clean up MTF member accidentally touches the tip with his glove, and his glove disappears along with the spire. It's found in some town where around half of the people there dropped dead and withered on the spot, because the glove was mostly carbon, and all the carbon was stolen from their bodies. The spire is found in the town, and it's got a carbon base with a solid oxygen tip (from the oxygen in the granite that built the town)

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The rules for the spire are pretty strict, so it's like a constant reminder that whatever the old tip was, all those atoms could immediately disappear in the center of a city, but it could also appear in the center of a forest, and be difficult to track down, so I feel that would draw people into the story. Also there's a mention near the beginning about testing being discontinued, so I feel people would want to see why

Additional Notes: The things that cause a teleportation event(work in progress name) are: The tip is touched with the same majority atom as the tip already had, so instead of staying the same it teleports. 108 hours pass without a tip change. If the tip is a radioactive element, the moment an atom in it decays, it undergoes the event (which is pretty much instantly). If the tip and base are the same element, it undergoes the event. If the tip is helium, it undergoes the event. I can explain more, as a lot of the info had to be cut down due to size limit.


As a courtesy to our readers on mobile devices, please collapse long posts. ~Zyn
